newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers PLN 200 mln of 5-yr bonds on Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers PLN 200 mln of 5-yr bonds on Feb 20.

text.p: Poland will offer 200 million zlotys of 12-percent five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 at a tender on February 20, the finance ministry said.
It said the value date for this tender will be March 5, 1997. The deadline for this auction is on 1200 local time (1100 GMT).
The paper comes from a three billion zloty issue of 12-percent five-year bonds, from which 1.736 billion was sold at four consecutive tenders from February to May 1996 period. @
The next auction of the paper is scheduled for March 20, 1997.
